verdict.rationale: Aircall's own docs show one bulk-style capability: importing up to 1,000 numbers into the dialer and calling them in sequence, plus API endpoints to create and launch campaigns. This is narrow, feature-specific batch handling, not general bulk operations across many items. Missing for 10: general bulk API endpoints (batch create, update or delete of contacts, users, calls or tags), documentation of bulk actions beyond dialing campaigns, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Import up to 1,000 numbers and dial them in sequence, with time between calls for notes and tags.
Create a Campaign ... Launch a Campaign ... Pause a Campaign ... Resume a Campaign
